resources.string: Browse all loaded recipes, including those you cannot make yet. Open a recipe to see its ingredients and preparation. You can edit any recipe. Recipes you add yourself can also be deleted.

Enter every ingredient, including water, oil and seasoning. Choose a suggested name or enter your own. Use the same name in your pantry. Use one row per ingredient. Water and salt stay in the instructions but are not checked against your pantry.
Write one preparation step per line.
Enter a whole number greater than zero.
This recipe version is no longer available for editing.
Some ingredients are missing or insufficient. Water and salt are not checked. You can still read this recipe below.
Delete “%1$s” from your recipe collection? This cannot be undone. Your pantry ingredients will stay saved.
Recipes appear when you have enough of all ingredients except water and salt. Water and salt do not need to be in your pantry. Oil and other seasoning still count.
No complete matches yet. Check your pantry names, quantities and units. Use maize meal for uncooked pap, or pap for cooked pap.
You have enough ingredients for this version. Water and salt are not checked.
Your pantry no longer has enough ingredients for this version, excluding water and salt. Return to recipes for current suggestions.
This recipe could not be found. Return to recipes and choose it again.
